verdict.rationale: The evidence shows reusable creative workflows ("Luma Skills: Build a Creative Workflow Once, Run It Forever") and multi-step Luma Agents. Neither documents cron-style or recurring scheduling: running a saved workflow on demand is not the same as running it on a recurring schedule. Scheduling is a fair axis for an agent and workflow platform, so the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
